response.description:
On September 1, 2026,
the cc_v5 confidential VM series will be retired and will no longer be
available for use or purchase. Any affected VM that has not been resized before
that date will deallocated. The impacted VM sizes that will be retired are: DCas_cc_v5,
DCads_cc_v5, ECas_cc_v5, and ECads_cc_v5.
response.title: Retirement: Nested confidential (cc_v5) VMs will be retired on September 1, 2026
